historical_record.description: Built as the Dunham, Carrigan & Hayden Co. warehouse, designed by Leo J. Devlin, with brick used for the exterior work.
Bought by Henry Adams and converted into the San Francisco Design Center, the first of the conversions that gave Showplace Square its name.
